visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with three people sitting on a grey couch against a white wall. In the center is a man wearing a black bob-cut wig, large red glasses, and a shiny red silk blouse. To his left is a woman with long black hair in a beige top, and to his right is a woman in a white turtleneck and blue knit hat. The man holds a yellow microphone and gestures with his free hand while speaking. (2) The scene shifts to a studio-like environment where the woman in the blue hat is crying and wiping her eyes with a tissue. The man in the red shirt stands next to her, also holding a microphone, looking concerned and comforting her. Red decorative scrolls with gold characters hang on the wall behind them. (3) Back on the couch, the woman in the beige top laughs while looking at the camera. A graphic overlay appears at the bottom showing a vintage photo of two girls in red outfits with matching short bob haircuts. The man and the women are engaged in a lively conversation, with the women using expressive hand gestures. (4) The three of them begin to sing enthusiastically into pink and yellow microphones. They sway and gesture to the rhythm. On-screen text and variety-style graphics pop up around them. (5) A series of quick cuts shows old album covers and music video clips of the duo 'China Dolls' from the late 90s, featuring their signature hairstyles and costumes. (6) The video moves to a wider shot in a room decorated for the Lunar New Year with red lanterns and banners. Five people, including the original three, stand together waving and cheering toward the camera. A man on the far left wears a red sports jacket, and another on the right wears a red hoodie. (7) The final frame is a static photo of the three main characters posing with their hands under their chins in a 'flower' gesture, smiling brightly against a plain white background with red text overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy Mandopop music begins with a driving electronic beat. A male voice speaks rapidly and with high excitement, followed by two female voices laughing. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect transitions to a scene with softer, more emotional vocal quality. A female voice is heard sniffling and speaking with a trembling, high-pitched tone, suggesting crying. (3) The pop music swells back in. The dominant male and female voices sing synchronized lyrics from a well-known retro track. The vocals are bright, well-projected, and exhibit high arousal. (4) A bubbly UI sound effect triggers a transition back to a conversational tone. The three speakers engage in a lively discussion with frequent laughter and overlapping speech. (5) Another cartoonish impact sound effect occurs as they mock-react to something. The background music maintains a constant 128 BPM electronic rhythm. (6) The video concludes with a collective shout of 'Happy New Year' (in Chinese) from multiple voices, accompanied by loud cheering and the music reaching a crescendo before a hard cut to silence.
